questions.question: What does the ratio delta f / delta x represent?
options: The slope of the tangent line
The slope of the secant line
questions.answer: The slope of the secant line
questions.explanation: The lecturer explicitly defines the ratio of delta f over delta x as the slope of the secant line.
questions.flashcard_front: What is the slope of the secant line?
questions.flashcard_back: The ratio of the change in function value (delta f) to the change in x (delta x).
questions.flashcard_explanation: The secant line connects two points; its slope is the rise over run, represented by delta f / delta x.

questions.question: The derivative is defined as the limit of the secant line slope as delta x approaches zero.
questions.explanation: The lecturer states that the derivative is the limit as delta x goes to 0 of the slope of the secant line.
questions.flashcard_front: How is the derivative defined using a limit?
questions.flashcard_back: The limit of the secant slope as delta x approaches zero.
questions.flashcard_explanation: The derivative is the instantaneous slope, found by shrinking the secant interval to zero.

questions.question: Write the formal limit definition of the derivative f'(x0) as presented in the lecture.
questions.answer: f'(x0) = limit as delta x approaches 0 of [f(x0 + delta x) - f(x0)] / delta x
questions.explanation: This is the formula the lecturer placed in a box as the most important formula of the day.
questions.flashcard_front: What is the formula for f'(x0)?
questions.flashcard_back: limit as delta x approaches 0 of [f(x0 + delta x) - f(x0)] / delta x.
questions.flashcard_explanation: This is the definition of the derivative as the limit of the difference quotient.

questions.question: If point P is at x0 and point Q is at x0 + delta x, what are the coordinates of point Q?
questions.explanation: The lecturer defines the x-coordinate as x0 + delta x and the y-coordinate as the function evaluated at that point.
questions.flashcard_front: What are the coordinates of point Q?
questions.flashcard_explanation: Q is the point on the curve shifted by delta x from the original point P.
